name: Escort Zora
description: A Escort Zora that follows a player. Two Escort Zora actors, two FZRA points, and a BARI barrier are required to trigger the associated cutscene.

fields.name: Second Zora
fields.description: Identifies this actor as the second Zora.

fields.name: Follow Player
fields.description: Enables player-following behavior. This option is activated when the player approaches the actor.

fields.name: Target Player
fields.description: Specifies which player the actor follows.

fields.name: First Rail ID
fields.description: Specifies a rail used during the associated cutscene. The actor selects the nearer of the two configured rails.

fields.name: Second Rail ID
fields.description: Specifies the other rail used during the associated cutscene. The actor selects the nearer of the two configured rails.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: Specifies the room variable set when the actor reaches its destination rail during the cutscene.
